component.name: HyperGSR
component.summary: Screen recorder whose camera follows your cursor

description.p: HyperGSR records your Linux desktop and zooms in on whatever you are working on, like a camera operator following the cursor. It reads the cursor position from the GPU's hardware cursor plane, so tracking keeps working on native Wayland windows.

ul.li: Spring-physics auto-zoom that settles in when the cursor rests and pulls back during fast travel
Custom zoom triggers: keys, mouse buttons, shake, or double-click
Hardware encoding with NVIDIA NVENC or VAAPI, with an x264 fallback
Screen capture through PipeWire and the desktop portal, asking for permission once
A compact Dynamic Island control bar with dark and light themes, plus a local Web Studio

description.p: The docked control bar needs a compositor with the wlr-layer-shell protocol, such as KDE Plasma, COSMIC, Hyprland, or Sway. Recordings are saved to your Videos folder.

screenshot.caption: Dynamic Island and Studio panel in the dark theme

description.p: Desktop integration: an app menu entry for npm installs, a Flatpak bundle, and an app ID shared by all install methods.
More accurate cursor tracking and packages that run outside a source checkout.
